name: What permits do I need for a residential renovation in Pasadena?

mainEntity.name: What permits do I need for a residential renovation in Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most residential renovation projects in Pasadena require permits from the City of Pasadena Planning and Building Department. This includes structural changes, electrical work, plumbing, significant alterations to the exterior, or adding new square footage. Even some interior remodels may need permits to ensure safety and code compliance. Minor cosmetic updates like painting or replacing flooring generally do not. Our team can help you identify and secure all necessary permits, ensuring your project meets local building codes and regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Many residential renovation projects in Pasadena require permits for structural, electrical, plumbing, or significant exterior changes. Our team assists with securing all necessary permits.
